resolveBuiltinToolPlan applies name/settings/session gates; createTools constructs selected entries in parallel and filters nulls, then stores canonical map. Calling BUILTIN_TOOLS[name] directly does not apply the plan: only createIf/class execution checks still apply. Therefore factory potential, registry membership, enabled selection and advertised active set are separate claims.

restrictToolNames=true normalizes supplied list or empty list; prevents most convenience widening, MCP/discovery/ordinary extension and settings-custom tools. Explicit SDK tools admitted only with allowRestrictedCustomTools; registered extension tools withheld. Checkpoint pair and required yield still force-included. SDK defaults restricted enableLsp=false and lspReadOnly=true.

Nonrestricted explicit list can add context_notes/new_context for read+grep with experimental management; ast_grep with grep; ast_edit with edit; memory retain/recall/reflect and Mnemopi memory_edit; external think; top-level autolearn manage_skill/learn; active goal. Among observed settings: astGrep.enabled false; astEdit.enabled true; find.enabled auto; github.enabled false; security.enabled false; checkpoint.enabled false; generate_image.enabled false; speechgen.enabled false; web_search.enabled true; tools.xdev true. Ordinary settings builtin reconcile excludes memory backend tool names other than learn; reruns same plan, removes only builtin ownership or native backing, preserves shadowing extension slots. Image/TTS reconcile owns entries separately and does not replace same-name extensions. Goal eager/lazy registration, memory and think callbacks reuse names already counted in maps; not additional named SDK tools.

SDK initial requested set filters registered names, excludes goal for lifecycle activation, and uses hidden/defaultInactive for default activation. Nonrestricted custom/extension/settings-owned winners automatically included unless hidden/defaultInactive; restricted caller owns active names. Autoresearch four are registered defaultInactive then activated by extension mode/branch state. HIDDEN_TOOLS map membership is not itself a tool.hidden=true property.

With tools.xdev and nonrestricted session, tools remain in canonical registry but discoverable presentation can move to xd://. Mountable requires loadMode=discoverable, excluding read/write transport and pinned todo/yield/ask/grep/web_search. Explicit requested names remain top-level. Builtin createTools default-all pass initially mounts only builtin-map entries; later SDK partitions full enabled custom/MCP slate. Device-only write may be added for explicit read without write. Mounting is not activation and not another tool name.

write xd://<tool> content is JSON argument object validated against canonical schema; help content gives docs. Dispatch accepts enabled union of mounted and top-level active names; listing remains mounted-only. Nonabort dispatch errors return isError. Inner approval policyKey uses canonical device name; ACP execution decorator preserved. Reserved resolve/reject/propose/report_issue route before normal xdev-state requirement.

Adapters default omitted loadMode to discoverable except known essential builtin names read/write/bash/edit/glob/find/eval/task/wait/learn/manage_skill/context_notes/new_context. Explicit declared mode wins. loadMode is presentation, not availability/permission.

For openai-codex with enabled JS-capable eval and setting on or auto+code_mode_only, direct keep-set is eval/ask/todo/yield/think/checkpoint/rewind/new_context plus enabled reserved bridge names and configured extraDirectTools. Other enabled tools accessed via eval bridge; not deleted or recreated. Exact wire aliases and collisions have deterministic namespace handling.

apply_patch is edit.customWireName only in that mode. Cursor six StrReplace synonyms select separate replace-mode bridge; legacy find factory means filename glob, not semantic builtin find. MCP mint lowercases/sanitizes retaining digits, strips redundant server prefix and caps long names with hash; legacy digit-stripped alias retained for deny/prompt policies. MCP emitted double-separator aliases resolved only against advertised+mounted reachable union, not full inactive registry.

AgentToolResult has content:(TextContent|ImageContent)[], optional details, isError, providerMetadata and useless. Thrown errors and isError are distinct; Error text or details.success=false alone is not automatically the same contract. Builtins get idempotent meta wrapper; SDK/custom/runtime/advisor paths wrap according to owner. Wrapper spills large text to artifacts, appends metadata notices and renders thrown ToolError as Error for loop; ExtensionToolWrapper performs revised-input approvals/hooks.

Listed schemas describe tool-owned parameters. When tools intent tracing is enabled and PI_NO_INTENT!=1, model wire schemas additionally inject i:string required by default. wait has optional i; eval/checkpoint/rewind derive intent and inject none; think/yield/goal/advise omit. Existing schema-owned i is not overwritten. Harness i stripped before tool execute unless schema-owned. This wire-only field must not be invented as a native schema argument or forgotten in provider manifests.

SDK constructs all BUILTIN_TOOLS factories for an advisor session without using resolveBuiltinToolPlan, then advisor runtime selects configured slate and adds advise. Instances are duplicates, not new map entries; factory-local createIf checks still matter. Default explicit-source behavior includes recall when built and does not widen user-owned advisor tools list.

validation.behavior: YAML frontmatter is optional for permissive providers; string name is trimmed, blank/nonstring name falls back to directory basename. Required-description scans check truthiness, not full specification compliance; runtime description is empty when metadata is not a string. Raw / or backslash names are rejected. General parser normalizes CRLF and kebab-case keys recursively, repairs near-miss YAML by default, and can fall back to simple key/value parsing with diagnostics. Conventional body parsing may remove HTML comments; invocation reparses with repair:false to retain body comments. globs/alwaysApply are metadata, not automatic invocation controls; allowed-tools is retained/validated metadata, not used by the skill invocation builder to grant or restrict actions.

Exactly these six raw frontmatter keys accepted; any other key rejects only that skill. Name trimmed and NFKC-normalized, <=64 Unicode codepoints, lowercase Unicode letters/digits/hyphens, no edge/double hyphens, matches normalized directory name. Description nonblank string <=1024 characters; compatibility <=500. Strict YAML fatal, repair:false, rawKeys:true; normalize keys only after validation. Skill identity uses on-disk directory basename. Root plugin manifest must target supported Agent Plugins 1.0.0 schema; fatal root violations reject components, missing skills/ is valid absence. hide/enabled/disable-model-invocation are not accepted by this provider despite conventional-loader support.

URL exact names use raw decoded host, with exact host/first-path-segment namespace match before bare-name relative-path interpretation. Decode path; reject absolute paths and .. components; require lexical containment in skill baseDir. With containRoot, canonical target including bare instruction/base-directory must remain in the canonical package root, allowing symlinks elsewhere within that package. Creation-location checks reject escaped/dangling/looping symlinks and file ancestors. Standard plugin discovery checks containment before listing/stat/read, including symlinked skills/ and SKILL.md. Uncontained conventional skills intentionally have lexical traversal checks but no realpath symlink boundary. Legacy Claude manifest paths are lexically bounded to plugin root, but conventional resulting skills are not assigned containRoot.

Skill scheme spec is backing=file, selectors=lines, immutable=true, unbounded=true, linkable=true. Internal shell filesystem serves bare skill://name as base directory, refuses mutations with EROFS and marks backing file handles readonly. Read tool does not mint mutable anchors for immutable skill text. This URI read-only policy is separate from ordinary physical filesystem access or subsequently executing scripts through terminal tooling; it is not a package execution sandbox.

sanitizeSkillName trims/lowercases then enforces ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,63}$; read admission requires exact safe shape. This is not strict Agent Skills kebab validation: trailing or consecutive hyphens can match. Description stripped of control/format chars, angle brackets, backticks, repeated tildes; collapse whitespace; sanitize on write and read. Body trimmed; both sanitized description and body must be nonempty; final serialized file <=64000 UTF-8 bytes including generated name/description YAML. Per-name in-process promise serialization; cross-process races explicitly outside that primitive's contract. Reject symlinked managed root and child directory. Create uses exclusive wx; update requires existing regular non-symlink single-link file, opens O_NOFOLLOW, checks opened handle, then truncates/writes. Delete rejects symlinked skill directory and missing target.

Publishing uses strict six-field Agent Skills validation against frontmatter name itself rather than checkout directory, plus ASCII single-hyphen name 1-64 and metadata.version required strict SemVer. metadata.keywords CSV <=20 entries each <=50 characters; repository/homepage HTTPS URLs; description <=1024. Recursive packing honors default ignores plus .skillignore gitignore subset (comments/negation/dir-only/anchored patterns), rejects symlinks/nonregular files/backslash names, caps 1000 files, 255-byte paths, 20 MiB unpacked, 5 MiB compressed, requires root SKILL.md remain included. Credential-shaped findings are path/1-based-line/kind; publish refuses unless --allow-secrets. Archive fixes metadata for deterministic bytes and SHA512 SRI.

Installer verifies SHA512 against expected registry/lock integrity before gzip/tar extraction.
